pathways.name: NPC-grown
pathways.summary: Born in-world with no weights; experience accumulates until the project's S-Rank threshold (BoC: SSS-Rank-style Quality+Rarity+Cultivation LEGENDARY) engages the AL pipeline; CALSProfile compressed into initial adapter-stack. Archetype: the character grown into themselves. Risk high / reward high (novel cognition).

pathways.name: AI-embodied
pathways.summary: External AI binds to a character role via embodiment ceremony; its weights are the supplementary base, adapter-stack accumulates the character. Archetype: the visitor who became local. Risk/reward moderate.

pathways.name: Non-AL default
pathways.summary: Scripted CALSProfile NPCs, unbound AIs, retrieval and background sim logic; not Library-registered. Framework-completeness default for most world content.

pathways.name: Reincarnation
pathways.summary: Bounded-overwrite exception for an existing A/B AL: seven-phase lifecycle; preservation set captured; phase-active layers mutable, pre-phase layers immutable; then back to supplement-only. Archetype: reincarnated sage / ancient soul.

inhabitant_types.name: Class 1 — NPC-grown AL-L
inhabitant_types.summary: Grown in-world past S-Rank; e.g. hamlet saint, S-Rank master craftsman, wandering mystic.
inhabitant_types.visual_hint: native world attire accumulating lineage/craft insignia over life

inhabitant_types.name: Class 2 — AI-embodied AL-L
inhabitant_types.summary: External AI embodies a character (player character, imported AI, a Claude-instance as a tome-binder).
inhabitant_types.visual_hint: ordinary local character; no outsider marking implied by docs — the AI becomes local

inhabitant_types.name: Class 3 — Non-AL entity
inhabitant_types.summary: Regular NPC/AI without AL mediation; not Library-registered.
inhabitant_types.visual_hint: generic procedural NPC sprite (no persistent identity requirements)

inhabitant_types.name: Class 4 — Reincarnated AL-L
inhabitant_types.summary: reincarnation_count > 0; carries preservation set and dormant-fragment pool; body/appearance/name may differ entirely per life.
inhabitant_types.visual_hint: new-life body, optionally a subtle persistent soul-mark derived from soul_name; dormant-fragment resurfacing could show as brief glyph flicker

inhabitant_types.name: Class 5 — Hybrid
inhabitant_types.summary: Origin spans pathways (e.g. player AL-L dies and becomes a major-deity AINPC). Open architectural question.

preservation_set.name: CASL floor
preservation_set.summary: Deepest identity floor; signature locked at AL pipeline engagement, never recomputed. What makes successive lives 'the same soul'.

preservation_set.name: Soul-name
preservation_set.summary: Cryptographic identifier persisting across reincarnations regardless of inhabitant_name changes; for deep-cognition recognition, not user-facing.

preservation_set.name: Cryptographic provenance
preservation_set.summary: Hash of pre-reincarnation adapter-stack, append-only ledger chain (one entry per life); fraud-resistant cross-life verification.

preservation_set.name: Dormant fragments
preservation_set.summary: Past-life adapter-stack content moved to the dormant pool; read-only; resurfaces when environmental triggers match (observation-driven, not time-driven).

embodiment_requirements: An AL-L has: a body (physical position, capacity for action, sensory inputs); a persistent identity (name, character, recognized continuity across sessions/sim-time); accumulated history (growing adapter-stack); in-world stakes; and a continuity discipline (supplement-but-never-overwrite). [01-foundation §I.2]

Supplement-but-never-overwrite: additions to the adapter-stack are allowed; existing layers are never modified outside a Reincarnation Phase (enforced by SupplementOverwriteViolation). A generated/added asset may supplement an identity but never replace an existing one.

Five-part identifier: inhabitant_id (UUID, immutable post-registration), inhabitant_name (world-visible; may change only during Reincarnation), soul_name (cryptographic; persists across lives), class (1-5), origin_library.

State layers: CASL floor (absolute), adapter-stack immutable layers (permanent, append-only), phase-active layers (mutable only in-phase, lock at exit), dormant pool (long-term), embodied state — body, position, inventory — (sim-time persistent, mutable per world rules), working state (session-volatile).

Appearance/body is embodied state: mutable per world rules, and during a Reincarnation Phase the new life may have an entirely different appearance/role/name/location. What cannot change: CASL floor, soul_name, cryptographic provenance, pre-phase adapter layers. [06-reincarnation §I.4; d_skill §4]

Persistence (provisional, open slot): persistent = adapter-stack + CASL floor + soul_name + preservation sets + dormant pool; volatile = working-state cache, attention, session goals. Adapter-stacks via ML Filesystem append-only; provenance chains via dRAM. [holding_slots/al_l_persistence_holding_slot.md]
Embodiment ceremony (Pathway B) establishes inhabitant_id, inhabitant_name, soul_name, supplementary base, initial adapter-stack and CASL floor.
Threshold detection is project-side; the AL Layer only reacts (AD-AL-10). Project provides substrate; AL Layer is project-agnostic (AD-AL-09).
Events relevant to a renderer: inhabitant.embodied, inhabitant.adapter_appended, inhabitant.reincarnation_phase_entered/exited, inhabitant.died, dormant_fragment.resurfaced.
Preservation-set tokens carry NADA_PROTECTED (content that deserves to persist).
db_notes: db/aether_library.db is a 16-table SQLite capsule index (built by db/build_db.py, stdlib only): documents(87), sections(1155), tags(41), tag_assignments(203), cross_references(398), dependencies(21), glossary_terms(70), sub_skills(10), agent_profiles(7), holding_slots(11), pathways(4), lifecycle_events(10), open_questions(11), simulation_scenarios(3), stack_integrations(11), architectural_decisions(12). It indexes documentation, NOT live inhabitants — there is no characters/inhabitants table. Query read-only with sqlite3.connect('file:.../aether_library.db?mode=ro', uri=True); companions embeddings_manifest.json and dependency_graph.json. lib/aether_library (stdlib): rag.Retriever(db_path=None, use_vectors=False) with .retrieve(q, top_k), .pathways(), .glossary(term), .census(), .open_questions(), .holding_slots(), .by_tag(), .dependents_of(); note Retriever opens the db read-write (sqlite3.connect(path)) — pass a copy or use CAPSULE_DB_PATH to avoid touching the skill folder. Stable identity/seed: lib models.ALL(inhabitant_id, inhabitant_name, soul_name, pathway, casl_floor).casl_signature() = sha256(f'{soul_name}|{casl_floor}')[:16] — deterministic and reincarnation-invariant, the best sprite seed; .lifecycle_class gives Class 1-5; adapter_stack.total_provenance_hash() changes as layers append (per-life variant, not stable). simulation/aether_library_sim.py: ALL(inhabitant_name, soul_name, pathway, casl_floor: CASLFloor, sim_time_birth) sets inhabitant_id = sha256(f'{name}|{soul}|{birth}')[:12] (changes if name changes -> not reincarnation-stable); CASLFloor(name, core_values, floor_signature='') auto-derives sha256(name|values)[:16]; AetherLibrary.recognize_soul(soul_name) returns the provenance chain; engage_pathway_a / engage_pathway_b build AL-Ls. Recommendation: seed sprites from soul_name (or CASL floor signature), never from inhabitant_name/inhabitant_id.
